title: Choose the visual world for laise-eduardo.com
question: The roll assigned the QC Inspection Tag. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: QC Inspection Tag
options.lineage: factory quality-control hang tags, 'Inspected by No. 7' slips, carbon-copy inspection forms
options.thesis: The portfolio is an inspection record: every claim carries a stamp and the evidence that earned it.
options.viewport: A single large kraft tag fills the first viewport: name and title stamped in condensed capitals, a PASSED stamp in green over the pitch, three proof lines (coverage, projects, CI) each seamed to a link, the primary action printed as a perforated tear-off slip.
options.risk: Reads as novelty if the stamps outnumber the facts; the tag must stay a document, not a costume.

raised.raise: Experience and projects are billed in order of importance, headline first, support below.
Every claim is stitched to its evidence: no number without a link beside it.
One-bit state discipline: active and hover invert to solid ink, no gradients or glows.

options.label: Engineering Drawing Title Block
options.lineage: ISO mechanical drawing sheets, revision tables, tolerance callouts
options.thesis: Laise as a specified part: tolerances, revisions, and a title block that says who checked it.
options.viewport: A drawing sheet with zone letters on the frame; the title block bottom-right holds name, title, location, and 'CHECKED BY' links; the sheet body carries callouts pointing at skills and projects.
options.risk: The most familiar 'precision' move for a technical portfolio; hairlines and grids can read generic.

options.label: Zoot-Era Dance Hall Handbill
options.lineage: two-ink letterpress handbills with stacked billing
options.thesis: The résumé as a bill: headline act first, support acts below, in plum and ochre.
options.viewport: A scalloped sheet with LAISE EDUARDO billed top in display caps, roles stacked beneath by importance.
options.case: Billing hierarchy maps cleanly onto a CV; recruiters identify less with a dance hall than with an inspection record.
options.risk: Nostalgic when the type is timid; fights the daylight office scene.

options.label: Memory Quilt Atlas
options.lineage: hand-pieced quilts with stitched provenance labels
options.thesis: Each project a patch, each caption seamed to its fabric.
options.viewport: A block grid of unequal patches, one per project, captions stitched beside them.
options.case: Provenance discipline is excellent; the domestic textile world does not read as test engineering to a recruiter.
options.kept: Every claim seamed to its evidence.

options.label: HyperCard Shoebox Stack
options.thesis: The portfolio as a stack of black-and-white cards you flip through.
options.viewport: A fixed card with painted buttons; Home card lists About, Skills, Work.
options.case: Charming to engineers over 45; obscures hierarchy and loses clarity on a 60-second scan.
options.kept: One-bit state discipline: inverted solid ink for active states.

options.label: Darkroom Under Safelight
options.thesis: Proof emerges slowly in the developer tray.
options.viewport: Amber-washed stations: compose, expose, develop; the CV develops as you scroll.
options.case: Dark amber ground contradicts the daylight office scene; slow reveal fights the 60-second scan.

options.label: Art Deco Cinema Lobby
options.lineage: stepped brass marquees and sunburst frames
options.thesis: Arrival staged through marquee, lobby, house.
options.viewport: Centered marquee with the name in stepped tiers over an ebony ground.
options.case: Spectacle over substance; a recruiter wants facts, not velvet rope.
options.kept: Mirrored center axis for the hero.

options.label: Versailles Axial Gardens
options.thesis: Sections as bosquets along one axis.
options.viewport: One long axis with symmetrical parterres of skills either side.
options.case: Audience does not identify; symmetry constrains a content-driven CV.
options.kept: Labels set along a single sightline.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The developer portfolio recruiters already know: hero, skills grid, project cards, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and title left, buttons below, project cards in a three-column grid.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the other fifty portfolios on the recruiter's screen.
